card.headline: Not forty goals. The few that matter.
card.body: Pin down the handful of targets that actually decide your year.

alt: Card showing a large letter T for Target, step one of the TRACE method.
linkedin:
Forty goals is the same as no goals.

The TRACE method has five steps: Target, Roadmap, Automation, Cadence, Enterprise. It starts with T for a reason.

Before anything gets built, we pin down the handful of targets that actually decide your year. Not forty. The few that matter. Every roadmap, automation, and meeting rhythm after that answers to those targets.

If you cannot name yours in one breath, start there.

The free Operations Audit Workbook at tracestrategies.com walks you through it.
